html:
In the app

Guided mode’s lesson 7 is this chapter: it checks that this lesson’s tags are made, that S5_Fill exists, is called from MainRoutine and verifies, and then watches the line while you run it and ticks each result as it happens:

  • A bottle is filled at the filler

The fill station needs five rungs: a request, the tube, the valves, a done latch and a clear. The request is written in the after-the-shift frame (it waits on Dwell.DN, which means the registers have just shifted and the belt is about to step), so it reads Exist bit 7 and Large bit 6 (chapter 10’s table). Add the JSR above JSR(S3_Index) and write:

Tags this lesson needs

Create these before you type the rungs (Verify reports any you miss as unknown). Tags from earlier lessons are not repeated.

TagTypeKindDescription
Fill_DoneBOOLbase tagLatched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps
Fill_TubeBOOLalias of Local:4:O.Data.6LogixPro O:2/6 · Lower the fill tube
LS5BOOLalias of Local:1:I.Data.10LogixPro I:1/10 · Large charge delivered
Large_FillBOOLalias of Local:4:O.Data.7LogixPro O:2/7 · Large fill valve
LS6BOOLalias of Local:1:I.Data.11LogixPro I:1/11 · Small charge delivered
Small_FillBOOLalias of Local:4:O.Data.8LogixPro O:2/8 · Small fill valve

The rungs

How it fits together

Rung 0: a bottle under the nozzle, not broken, not yet filled, the registers shifted, the belt not stepping, the line running → Fill_Req. The request is an OTE, so it drops the moment Fill_Done latches. Rung 1 lowers the tube while requested; the filler reports LS4 (tube down). Rung 2 opens a valve once the tube is down: a branch with the large valve on one leg and the small valve on the other, chosen by the Large register, each held until the filler’s own sensor (LS5 large charge, LS6 small) says the charge is in. One rung for both sizes means it works on whichever bottle reaches the filler first. Rung 3 latches Fill_Done at that moment, which drops the request and lifts the tube, and rung 4 unlatches it when the belt steps so the next bottle is treated as new. Step 3 will not let the belt step while the tube is down or the request is on.

Run it

Start the line. At stop 7 the tube comes down and the bottle fills (a large charge for a large bottle, a small one for a small; watch the lamps on the filler’s post), then the tube lifts and the belt steps. The Simulator Log lists every fill. The filler tops its head tank up from the reservoir, and the reservoir is going down: step 6 keeps it supplied.

Try it

Why is the bottle Exist 7 but Large 6? Count the sensors: LS2 is one stop past LS1, so the same bottle is one bit further along in Exist than in Large. Then move JSR(S3_Index) above JSR(S5_Fill) in MainRoutine and run: the belt steps in the same scan the fill is asked for, and bottles leave the filler empty. Put it back. That is the scan-order lesson in one move.

rungs.head: S5_Fill · Rung 0
rungs.comment: FILL REQUEST: the registers have just shifted (Dwell.DN), Exist bit 7 says a bottle stands under the nozzle and Broken bit 5 says it is whole; it has not had its charge yet. The shift happens at the END of the dwell, so a rung that runs after it reads one bit higher than a rung that runs during the dwell. A broken bottle gets no charge: it would only run out onto the belt

pred.q: Exist[0].7 is off, Broken[0].5 is on, Dwell.DN is off, Fill_Done is on, Conv_Index is on and Line_Run is on. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is false: Fill_Req is off. It stops at XIC(Exist[0].7).

rungs.words: When Exist[0].7 (Bottle present, one bit per stop (LogixPro B3:10). During the dwell: filler 6, capper 9, scrap gate 13, divert gate 20; after the shift (Dwell.DN) one bit higher) is on, Broken[0].5 (Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher) is off, Dwell.DN (the done bit of Dwell: Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle) is on, Fill_Done (Latched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps) is off, Conv_Index (Latched while the belt steps one pitch) is off and Line_Run (Seal-in run bit (LogixPro B3:0/0)) is on, the rung turns Fill_Req (A bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Exist[0].7) Examine If Closed asks: true when Exist[0].7 is on.
  2. XIO(Broken[0].5) Examine If Open asks: true when Broken[0].5 is off.
  3. XIC(Dwell.DN) Examine If Closed asks: true when Dwell.DN is on.
  4. XIO(Fill_Done) Examine If Open asks: true when Fill_Done is off.
  5. XIO(Conv_Index) Examine If Open asks: true when Conv_Index is off.
  6. XIC(Line_Run) Examine If Closed asks: true when Line_Run is on.
  7. OTE(Fill_Req) Output Energize does: turns Fill_Req on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S5_Fill · Rung 1
rungs.comment: Tube down while a fill is requested; it comes back up the moment Fill_Done latches
rungs.words: When Fill_Req (A bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge) is on, the rung turns Fill_Tube (LogixPro O:2/6 · Lower the fill tube) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Fill_Req) Examine If Closed asks: true when Fill_Req is on.
  2. OTE(Fill_Tube) Output Energize does: turns Fill_Tube on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S5_Fill · Rung 2
rungs.comment: VALVES, once the tube is down (LS4): the large valve for a large bottle until the large charge is in (LS5), the small valve otherwise until LS6. Large[0].6, not .9: LS2 sits 40 px past LS1 and sees the bottle earlier, so the Large register runs one bit ahead of Exist

pred.q: Fill_Req is off, LS4 is on, Large[0].6 is on, LS5 is off and LS6 is on. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is false: Large_Fill is off and Small_Fill is off. It stops at XIC(Fill_Req).

rungs.words: When Fill_Req (A bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge) is on and LS4 (LogixPro I:1/9 · Fill tube down) is on, each path is tested on its own: if Large[0].6 (Large bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher) is on and LS5 (LogixPro I:1/10 · Large charge delivered) is off, it turns Large_Fill (LogixPro O:2/7 · Large fill valve) on (and off whenever the rung is false); if Large[0].6 is off and LS6 (LogixPro I:1/11 · Small charge delivered) is off, it turns Small_Fill (LogixPro O:2/8 · Small fill valve) on (and off whenever the rung is false).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Fill_Req) Examine If Closed asks: true when Fill_Req is on.
  2. XIC(LS4) Examine If Closed asks: true when LS4 is on.
  3. A branch of 2 parallel paths: each path is tested on its own and does its own work.
    Path 1
    1. XIC(Large[0].6) Examine If Closed asks: true when Large[0].6 is on.
    2. XIO(LS5) Examine If Open asks: true when LS5 is off.
    3. OTE(Large_Fill) Output Energize does: turns Large_Fill on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.
    Path 2
    1. XIO(Large[0].6) Examine If Open asks: true when Large[0].6 is off.
    2. XIO(LS6) Examine If Open asks: true when LS6 is off.
    3. OTE(Small_Fill) Output Energize does: turns Small_Fill on (and off whenever the rung is false). Every scan it writes the rung state: true on, false off.

rungs.head: S5_Fill · Rung 3
rungs.comment: Charge delivered: latch Fill_Done, which drops Fill_Req, closes the valve and lifts the tube
rungs.words: When Fill_Req (A bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge) is on and either (LS5 (LogixPro I:1/10 · Large charge delivered) is on) or (LS6 (LogixPro I:1/11 · Small charge delivered) is on), the rung latches Fill_Done (Latched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps) on.
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Fill_Req) Examine If Closed asks: true when Fill_Req is on.
  2. A branch of 2 parallel paths: power gets through if any one of them is true.
    Path 1
    1. XIC(LS5) Examine If Closed asks: true when LS5 is on.
    Path 2
    1. XIC(LS6) Examine If Closed asks: true when LS6 is on.
  3. OTL(Fill_Done) Output Latch does: latches Fill_Done on. It only ever sets the bit; the bit stays on after the rung goes false.

pats.why: Fill_Done stays on after this rung goes false; only an OTU somewhere else turns it off. Read the program for that OTU before you trust the bit.
pats.think: a light switch rather than a doorbell: flick it on and it stays on until someone flicks it off.
pats.watch: A latched bit survives a stop, and it survives a download that keeps tag values. If nothing ever unlatches it, the machine remembers a state that is long gone.

rungs.head: S5_Fill · Rung 4
rungs.comment: The belt is stepping: the next bottle will need its own charge

pred.q: Conv_Index is on. What does the rung do?
pred.a: The rung is true: Fill_Done is unlatched.

rungs.words: When Conv_Index (Latched while the belt steps one pitch) is on, the rung unlatches Fill_Done (Latched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Conv_Index) Examine If Closed asks: true when Conv_Index is on.
  2. OTU(Fill_Done) Output Unlatch does: unlatches Fill_Done. It only ever clears the bit.

pats.why: This rung is the other half of a latch: it clears Fill_Done when its conditions are met, and does nothing otherwise.

Exist.desc: Bottle present, one bit per stop (LogixPro B3:10). During the dwell: filler 6, capper 9, scrap gate 13, divert gate 20; after the shift (Dwell.DN) one bit higher

Broken.desc: Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher

Dwell.desc: Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle

Fill_Done.desc: Latched when the charge is in; cleared when the belt steps

Conv_Index.desc: Latched while the belt steps one pitch

Fill_Req.desc: A bottle stands under the filler and still needs its charge

Fill_Tube.desc: LogixPro O:2/6 · Lower the fill tube

Large.desc: Large bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher
